name: sprint-planning
description: Facilitates sprint planning with security debt baked in: capacity planning from rolling velocity, risk-weighted prioritization balancing feature value against security debt, commitment sizing, and a DevSecOps definition of done. For writing or refining the stories themselves, use user-story-writing instead. Triggers on: "plan the sprint", "sprint planning", "prioritize these stories", "how much can we commit", "balance security debt against features", "sprint capacity".
